The INN at BOWMAN was originally built in 1948 as a private summer residence in Randolphs hiking mountains.  The Inn  has been completely renovated by graciously combining twentieth century comfort with luxury, charm and a friendly ambiance. The rooms are meticulously appointed with furnishing which offer guests an air of comfort and welcome!  A bountiful continental breakfast is served in the dinette  room where guests can meet to socialize.  Each room has fresh flowers in season and plush towels, flannel sheet in the winter months and all the comforts of home.  Although the INN is a non-smoking guest house, smokers are welcomed on the front porch.  We are located within an hours drive of many of the White Mountains famous parks, and landmarks, which include: Bretton Woods ski and zip line, Sunday River ski area, Tuckermans Ravine for hikers, Wildcat Mt for skiing, the Weathervane Theater for summer entertainment and the Waumbec Gold course ~ an 18 hole championship golf course Situated in Randolph, 49 km from North Conway, Inn At Bowman features a seasonal outdoor swimming pool and free WiFi.

The bed and breakfast offers a flat-screen TV and a private bathroom with bathrobes, a hairdryer and shower. For added convenience, the property can provide towels and bed linen for an extra charge.

Guests at Inn At Bowman can enjoy a continental or a buffet breakfast.
